summary: Axe Compute Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) announcing a 36-month enterprise infrastructure contract with an unnamed customer valued at $260 million. The company will deliver a cluster of 2,304 NVIDIA B300 GPUs with AI-focused storage from a U.S. Tier 3 data center. Deployment is targeted for Q3 2026, with a deposit, prepayment, and monthly take-or-pay structure. This is a routine customer contract, not a special situation; no M&A, activist, or strategic event is involved. The filing provides no board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics beyond standard commercial terms.
